verses.text: Whensoever a man desireth aught above measure, immediately he becometh restless.
verses.modernizedText: Whenever a person desires anything beyond measure, he immediately becomes restless.

verses.text: The proud and the avaricious man are never at rest; while the poor and lowly of heart abide in the multitude of peace.
verses.modernizedText: The proud and the greedy are never at rest, while the poor and humble in heart live in abundant peace.

verses.text: The man who is not yet wholly dead to self, is soon tempted, and is overcome in small and trifling matters.
verses.modernizedText: The person who is not yet wholly dead to self is soon tempted and overcome in small and trifling matters.

verses.text: It is hard for him who is weak in spirit, and still in part carnal and inclined to the pleasures of sense, to withdraw himself altogether from earthly desires.
verses.modernizedText: It is hard for someone who is weak in spirit, still partly carnal, and inclined to the pleasures of the senses to withdraw completely from earthly desires.

verses.text: And therefore, when he withdraweth himself from these, he is often sad, and easily angered too if any oppose his will.
verses.modernizedText: And therefore, when he withdraws from these, he is often sad and easily angered if anyone opposes his will.

verses.text: But if, on the other hand, he yield to his inclination, immediately he is weighed down by the condemnation of his conscience; for that he hath followed his own desire, and yet in no way attained the peace which he hoped for.
verses.modernizedText: But if, on the other hand, he yields to his inclination, he is immediately weighed down by the condemnation of his conscience; for he has followed his own desire and yet has in no way attained the peace he hoped for.

verses.text: For true peace of heart is to be found in resisting passion, not in yielding to it.
verses.modernizedText: For true peace of heart is found in resisting passion, not in yielding to it.

verses.text: And therefore there is no peace in the heart of a man who is carnal, nor in him who is given up to the things that are without him, but only in him who is fervent towards God and living the life of the Spirit.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore, there is no peace in the heart of a carnal person or in one who is given up to outward things, but only in one who is fervent toward God and lives the life of the Spirit.
